text_blocks.snippet: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) often shows no signs in its early stages, but as it gets worse, it causes strain on the heart and lungs.
snippet_highlighted_words: strain on the heart and lungs

list.snippet: Shortness of breath (dyspnea) during daily tasks or exercise
Dizziness or lightheadedness, especially when active
Chest pain or pressure from heart strain
Heart palpitations (a racing or pounding heartbeat)
Swelling (edema) in the ankles, feet, legs, or belly
Bluish lips or fingers (cyanosis) from low oxygen

text_blocks.snippet: For a deeper overview of signs and support resources, visit the American Lung Association.
If you or someone you know is experiencing these signs, share which symptoms are most concerning or if they happen at rest so I can provide more relevant information.
